author: lilianweng
text: 😊Self-supervised learning opens up a huge opportunity for better utilizing unlabelled data while learning in a supervised learning manner. My latest post covers many interesting ideas of self-supervised learning tasks on images, videos & control problems: https://t.co/SdUrQQDzzy

author: lilianweng
text: It has been a long journey for us. There were moments when I felt disappointed or almost hopeless, but the progress we have made, together as a team, is credible. We made it through and made it happen. Check it out!!

quoted.text:
We've trained an AI system to solve the Rubik's Cube with a human-like robot hand.

This is an unprecedented level of dexterity for a robot, and is hard even for humans to do.

The system trains in an imperfect simulation and quickly adapts to reality: https://t.co/O04izt3KvO https://t.co/8lGhU2pPck

text: Recommendation is only applied to season 1. Season 2 is badly disappointing 😰🙄
